outcome.wording: On the enlarged object-ID-joined set (4676 of 5,679 lineage rows, 82.34%, against the original join's 51.0%), the seal/tablet difference in TERMINAL14 endings replicates within sites: Mantel–Haenszel odds ratio 2.452, 95% CI [1.965–3.058], entirely above 1.5, family-adjusted q = 0.0001. The original F1 result was not an artefact of which rows the concordance join could reach, at this test's resolution. Leave-one-site-out: every dropped-site subset remained estimable with its interval excluding 1; no site is load-bearing. This is a statement about recorded use in this lineage layer, not about what the difference means.
